blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to stop, to bring to stop
to write down, to enter (to set something down in writing)
to hear out, to listen (to the end)
to deceive, to cheat, to trick, to swindle
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: остана́вливать — to stop, to bring to stop; запи́сывать — to write down, to enter (to set something down in writing); выслу́шивать — to hear out, to listen (to the end); обма́нывать — to deceive, to cheat, to trick, to swindle.
**вспы́хивать** — to flash (to briefly illuminate a scene). Wiktionary: вспы́хнуть + -ивать.
**подхва́тывать** — to catch (up), to pick up, to grasp, to snatch. Wiktionary: подхвати́ть + -ывать.
**дога́дываться** — to guess (to reach an unqualified conclusion). Wiktionary: догада́ться + -ывать.
**выска́кивать** — to jump out, to leap out. Wiktionary: выскочить + -ивать.
